rationale: AD-352 and epic #880. The native TypeScript collector gives the output of the Python default, so the host launches it as the bundled producer. Two line-bound type-ignore exemptions of process.py follow their moved lines: ProcessCollector gains the field bundled, which lets the binary of this package lie in the scanned root. No requires entry, Any permission, interface or coupling budget changes: the launcher is part of archkeel.cli.observe.
